111230901.text: Kun Jun! We need to get going!

111230904.text: There are many beautiful rocks here, but nothing out of the ordinary. I couldn't find any clues.

111230905.text: Then again, the memories of ore can shift with the passage of time and the changing of the environment.

111230906.text: Is there a pattern to it?

111230907.text: Hmm, difficult to say... I feel that ore memories tend to be from the recent past.

111230908.text: So there's never any ancient memories?

111230909.text: Rocks endure, but as eons pass their memories are erased. Those memories that survive are rooted in powerful emotion or thought.

111230910.text: That makes sense — it is the same for people!

subQuests.subQuestName: Head to the ancient tree and investigate

111230102.text: And there's so many mysterious-looking crystals up there too... amazing.

111230104.text: Let's conduct separate investigations. I'll take that area, perhaps you could survey this section.

111230108.text: Kun Jun, can you see anything worth investigating?

111230109.text: Well... there is this stone tablet here.

111230110.text: Doesn't seem very interesting... Paimon's gonna look over there.

111230111.text: Huh? It's worth a try, surely. Let me see...

111230116.text: ...Just a bit light-headed... It's passed, nothing to worry about.

111230119.text: #*sigh* Whatever, Paimon's going to investigate over there. Why don't you climb the tree and have a look, {NICKNAME}?

111230120.text: You're sure there'll be clues in the tree?

111230121.text: If you don't try you don't know! Anyway, you'll be able to get a good look at our surroundings from up there!

111230124.text: When has Paimon ever come up with a bad idea, hmm?

111230125.text: Wait a minute... Paimon can fly! *sigh* Alright, Paimon will go, you wait here, Paimon will—

111230127.text: Huh? Zhongli's voice came from... behind the tree. Did he find another clue?

111230128.text: Quick, let's go see! Maybe he found another miner!

111230201.text: This has been newly dug. It would appear our answer is up ahead.

111230202.text: Is that a voice coming from the tunnel? Eek! Someone else go first!

111230203.text: Compose yourselves. I will lead us in.

111230205.text: There is an unusual presence emanating from inside the tunnel. Prepare yourselves, and tread lightly.

subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the Domain at the end of the underground tunnel
Learn the truth of the situation

111230601.text: Morax! A thousand years after you sealed me underground... you return for the second time...

111230603.text: You should call it by its name, Azhdaha... fate.

111230606.text: So here lies the wisdom of the gods? Destroy all deemed redundant, enlist tyrants to ravage the wilderness!

111230614.text: During the battle... you embued us with your power...

111230615.text: Haha... yes. It was all I could manage.

111230618.text: Forgive me for concealing the truth, Traveler. There were things that only became clear to me upon reaching this tree.

111230619.text: Allow me to elaborate. I am not Azhdaha the whole... but a fragment.

111230620.text: Heaven and earth, yin and yang, opposing forces... You can consider the existence of me and the Azhdaha you see there, to be a reflection of such polarities. "We" are a schism of the will... the will of Azhdaha.

111230621.text: So... so there are two Azhdahas!?

111230622.text: No! It can't be! That's impossible...!

111230623.text: When the seal loosened, your power manifested in this world as a child. With this new identity, you were able to vent about the forces that suppressed you... but would anyone listen... would they even care?

111230624.text: That's when it occurred to you. The loosening of the seal constituted an opportunity to strike back. Kidnapping the miners was all in aid of digging to the entrance to the seal itself. Your plan was to launch an attack on both ends. From outside... and within. Thereby fully destroying the seal.

111230625.text: The audacity! Are you insane!? If you truly are a part of me, how is it you find yourself standing on the side of the betrayer!?

111230626.text: I was another power awakened with the loosening of the seal. Too weak to reincarnate, but strong enough to possess a human body.

111230627.text: I was barely conscious... I couldn't remember who I was. Only the past would elicit a reaction from me... But my aim was clear: Find Morax... and aid him in stopping you.

111230628.text: I had sensed that something was amiss when you mentioned Dragonfall. Had your power been but a little stronger, I would've recognized you.

111230629.text: Don't blame yourself, I have changed beyond all recognition. Only when I touched the stone tablet... did I truly remember.

111230630.text: It's been so long. A secret beyond all comprehension, of youthful humanity and ancient dragon-kind... Morax, do you want to tell the tale?

111230631.text: There would be no harm in it. The decision is yours.

111230632.text: Haha, you haven't changed. Then allow me.

111230633.text: Azhdaha was once a friend and ally of the Geo Archon, Morax, with a lifespan far exceeding that of mankind. However, that which is derived of the earth is no more or less than the earth itself...

111230634.text: The memories of rocks do not last long. Those memories that survive are rooted in powerful emotion. But as time passes, so these memories fade into obscurity. Erosion is the world's greatest destroyer of memories.

111230636.text: Erosion ground Azhdaha's consciousness into oblivion. Slowly, he forgot the face of his old friend, and his memories of defending Liyue Harbor disintegrated.

111230637.text: Azhdaha, now incomplete, became irascible... aggressive.

111230638.text: What would you expect!? It was humanity that attacked the Ley Lines that sustained me!

111230639.text: This much is true. Which is why "you" attacked The Chasm... why "you" waged war against Morax.

111230640.text: In the beginning, in order to open up new territory and increase production, the citizens of Liyue came to the mountains to mine. Overexploitation caused the Ley Lines to quake, which brought untold suffering to "us."

111230641.text: Erosion made "us" even more savage. No matter how we struggled, we lost the ability to coexist with humanity... we lost all reason.

111230642.text: Morax shared with us some of his power, to prevent further erosion. But... it was futile. Everything returns to dust. It is the natural order, an unstoppable force.

111230643.text: And so, "we" became "you." And from your will... "I" emerged.

111230645.text: I am your final contract. Witness the promise between Azhdaha and Morax. You can hate me... but you cannot deny me.

111230647.text: I am the remnants of Azhdaha's benevolence, the echo of a contract set in stone. I harbor a willingness to go further, a willingness to coexist peacefully with mankind.

111230648.text: No, no! It is I, Azhdaha, forged of elemental crystal, bearer of the weight and memories of the earth, older than the mountains and the oceans that decides! I will not swear allegiance to this insect!

111230650.text: A lord over insects is nothing but an insect in turn!

111230651.text: You forgot yourself. Nobody held Morax in higher regard than you or I.

111230652.text: That which you have forgotten, I hold here in my heart. If you are the memory of the earth... then I am the memory of coexistence... of coexistence with humanity.

111230653.text: All powers under heaven, rise and fall of land and sea...

111230654.text: ...A star appears within the wild... a sun ascends as bright as... jade...

111230656.text: Strange... What... what is this feeling? And all this...

111230657.text: You are spent, and I will soon disappear. Before I do, heed these words.

111230658.text: In the wilderness, snow falls on a spring day. In an instant it will melt. Even where it is fleeting and leaves no trace. Even where it will never fall again...

111230659.text: No, that isn't true! I don't accept this as fate!

111230660.text: Perhaps it isn't. But it remains... an inevitable misfortune.

111230701.text: So there you are! My men and I found your clues and followed them straight here.

111230702.text: We found Mao in a tent at the campsite unconscious! It seems he'll be okay. Sadly, we found no trace of the other three...

111230704.text: Nothing, pay it no mind. Those three miners are over in that cave there.

111230706.text: They're exhausted, but not in danger. Don't worry.

111230707.text: R—Right, well... Thank you, all of you! I better go and see how they're doing.

111230708.text: So you're taking them back to Liyue Harbor?

111230711.text: No problem! You rescued my men. I'll be happy to assist all of you in any way I can. I'll be back soon, I need to assess their condition.

111230712.text: Kun Jun... Oh, uh... we should be calling you Azhdaha... You're coming back to Liyue Harbor too, right?

111230714.text: Once I'm gone, the true owner will accompany the miners back to Liyue. Kun Jun hails from a family of famous artisans — he too will be famous in time. It would be a shame for someone of his talent to go missing.

111230715.text: You always did have a great admiration for blacksmiths.

111230716.text: Curious how swords and daggers are blind, yet their creators see so much. Perhaps empathy is mankind's proudest achievement after all?

111230717.text: Azhdaha. I am no longer the Geo Archon.

111230719.text: Today I am just an ordinary citizen of Liyue.

111230720.text: Even you met such a fate... Let's get the difficult part out of the way. I cannot guarantee that I won't be awoken a second time.

111230721.text: No matter. If that day comes to pass, Liyue must prepare itself to face you.

111230722.text: And how will Liyue fare without Rex Lapis?

111230723.text: Even without a god above, this remains a nation of men. I was once their god, I ought to be here to witness their rise and fall.

111230724.text: All life is shaped and then ground away by the endless flow of time. You were always the strongest among us, yet it would seem that even you have been eroded...

111230725.text: That's unimportant... fate is ordained by heaven. Even if our mission had already concluded, it would be cowardly not to strike out on the road of departure.

111230726.text: You may live forever, doomed to a lonely existence... yet even this is temporary. When you reach the end of time, those people, those past and future relationships predetermined by fate... They will be waiting for you.

111230727.text: I do not pretend to match your rhetoric when it comes to the subject of a life long-lived. I fear that the life of an elemental being is longer than any in this world.

111230728.text: Were it not so, you would have killed me long ago, and would not be having to face me again now.

111230729.text: You've brought a smile to my face. When all is said and done, a reunion between old friends is an auspicious occasion.

111230730.text: That day in The Chasm? Did you hesitate?

111230731.text: A heart of stone is a heart nonetheless. But I am the God of Contracts, and was, for a time, a god of the people of Liyue.

111230732.text: You chose justice, but did not forsake your kindness. You came to me not as an assassin, and so I was willingly sealed away.

111230733.text: The movements of the Earth Dragon can tremble the earth and shake the heavens. With your abilities, even at my full strength, I struggled to confront you, let alone seal you away.

111230735.text: Do not forget that I was there with Liyue's founder. The face may have changed, but the content of the contract remains intact.

111230736.text: Old friend, God of Contracts. I hereby honor our agreement.

111230739.text: My life is nigh on eternal. I will go on with the infinite flow of time. And you, Morax... You too will live for many a day to come.

111230742.text: If it is fated, Morax... we will meet again.

111230746.text: Yes. Don't be alarmed, he's only asleep.

111230747.text: Whoa... that was so weird. It was like he... suddenly became another person.

111230748.text: In fact... we have yet to meet the real Kun Jun.

111230750.text: He was a great friend of yours.

111230752.text: Centuries may have passed since then... but events from a thousand years ago... remain crystal clear in my mind.

111230801.text: A thousand years ago, Azhdaha attacked The Chasm. I tried to obstruct him, fighting him tooth and nail down the length and breadth of the mine. Finally, I brought him down, and sealed him underground.

111230802.text: During that battle, Dragonfall was born. Azhdaha could sense the stone. Subconsciously, he wanted to use it to find me.

111230803.text: Despite being the victor, I could not claim to be stronger than he. And in his heart, he still retained an ounce of good will towards me... towards Liyue... towards life above ground.

111230804.text: He was willing to be sealed away. But as the erosion set in... he forgot.

111230807.text: Even I cannot avoid it. But there is something I understand better than most: When the door opens, it is time to leave.

111230808.text: The greater the power, the greater the danger erosion may bring about. The millennia may come and go, but even a stone may tire.

111239901.text: Huh? How did we get here? We need to go back and check on the miners!
